d:
Scott Galloway, Professor of Marketing at NYU's Stern School of Business, on why the middle class is dying by design and who is winning.
He explains:
• Why he believes the middle class is an accident of history, not a permanent feature of modern economies
• How $50 trillion moved from the bottom 90 percent to the top 10 percent and who engineered that shift
• How to build wealth in your 20s and 30s
• Why the real economic war is between incumbents and entrants, not rich versus poor
• How your phone is designed to make you feel like a failure and why that feeling is intentional
